SELECT pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(843001)
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp

DO $$ BEGIN IF current_database() <> 'hmi_mes_demo' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected database'; END IF; IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.alembic_version) <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alembic_version WHERE version_num='0019_registration_ids') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected schema revision or database'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_migrator') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_app') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated roles required'; END IF; IF (SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public') IS DISTINCT FROM 'hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('public.alembic_version') AND relowner='hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid AND relkind='r') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated migrator ownership required'; END IF; END $$
SET LOCAL ROLE hmi_migrator
SET LOCAL search_path = public, pg_temp

CREATE TABLE line_queue_policies (
        line_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES lines(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        revision numeric(20,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            CHECK(revision BETWEEN 0 AND 18446744073709551615),
        source_id text, stream_id text, gateway_id text,
        capture_generation numeric(20,0)
            CHECK(capture_generation BETWEEN 0 AND 18446744073709551615),
        auto_advance boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        enabled_by text REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        blocked_reason text,
        FOREIGN KEY(source_id,stream_id) REFERENCES source_streams(source_id,stream_id)
            ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        CHECK(NOT auto_advance OR (source_id IS NOT NULL AND stream_id IS NOT NULL
            AND gateway_id IS NOT NULL AND capture_generation IS NOT NULL
            AND enabled_by IS NOT NULL))
    )

CREATE TABLE line_queue_entries (
        entry_id text PRIMARY KEY CHECK(entry_id ~ '^[^[:space:]]{1,128}$'),
        line_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lines(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        position integer NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0),
        work_order_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES work_orders(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        expected_row_version numeric(20,0) NOT NULL
            CHECK(expected_row_version BETWEEN 1 AND 18446744073709551615),
        load_command_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE
            CHECK(load_command_id ~ '^[^[:space:]]{1,128}$'),
        state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WAITING' CHECK(state IN ('WAITING','BOUND','REMOVED')),
        binding_receipt jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(binding_receipt)='object'),
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        CHECK(state <> 'BOUND' OR binding_receipt IS NOT NULL)
    )

CREATE INDEX ix_line_queue_entries_order
        ON line_queue_entries(line_id,state,position,entry_id)

CREATE TRIGGER line_queue_entries_preserve
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON line_queue_entries FOR EACH ROW
        EXECUTE FUNCTION preserve_line_queue_entry()

CREATE TRIGGER line_queue_entries_no_truncate
        BEFORE TRUNCATE ON line_queue_entries FOR EACH STATEMENT
        EXECUTE FUNCTION preserve_line_queue_entry()

CREATE TABLE line_queue_updates (
        request_id text PRIMARY KEY CHECK(request_id ~ '^[^[:space:]]{1,128}$'),
        line_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lines(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        actor text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        original_intent jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(original_intent)='object'),
        receipt jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(receipt)='object'),
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE line_queue_audit (
        id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
        line_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lines(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        actor text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        action text NOT NULL,
        occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        evidence jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(evidence)='object')
    )

CREATE INDEX ix_line_queue_audit_line
        ON line_queue_audit(line_id,id)

CREATE FUNCTION immutable_line_queue_evidence() RETURNS trigger
        LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Line queue audit and request receipts are immutable';
        END $$

CREATE TRIGGER line_queue_updates_immutable
            BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON line_queue_updates FOR EACH ROW
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_line_queue_evidence()

CREATE TRIGGER line_queue_updates_no_truncate
            BEFORE TRUNCATE ON line_queue_updates FOR EACH STATEMENT
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_line_queue_evidence()

CREATE TRIGGER line_queue_audit_immutable
            BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON line_queue_audit FOR EACH ROW
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_line_queue_evidence()

CREATE TRIGGER line_queue_audit_no_truncate
            BEFORE TRUNCATE ON line_queue_audit FOR EACH STATEMENT
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_line_queue_evidence()
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
UPDATE public.alembic_version SET version_num='0020_line_queue' WHERE version_num='0019_registration_ids'
